figures.name: Shiva

ability.name: Tandava
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to all enemies; reset all card positions; ally stats cannot be reduced for 1 turn.

figures.description: The supreme Shaiva deity who destroys the universe at the end of time and dances it back into being.

figures.name: Parvati

ability.name: Shakti's Grace
ability.description: Restore full HP to one ally; grant all goddess allies +3 to all stats.

figures.description: Divine consort of Shiva whose fierce love and absolute devotion transformed her into the embodiment of Shakti power.

figures.name: Ganesha

ability.name: Remover of Obstacles
ability.description: Remove all negative effects from all allies; the next enemy ability is automatically blocked.

figures.description: Elephant-headed son of Shiva who must be propitiated at the start of all undertakings to remove obstacles.

figures.name: Kali

ability.name: Kali's Dance
ability.description: Destroy one enemy permanently; all dark-aligned allies gain +3 power from the energy released.

figures.description: The fierce black goddess of time and destruction who dances on Shiva's body and drinks demon blood.

figures.name: Nandi

ability.name: Gate Keeper
ability.description: Block all enemy abilities that have not been previously witnessed; guard Shiva allies.

figures.description: The sacred white bull and vehicle of Shiva who stands guard at all Shaiva temples and transmits teachings.

figures.name: Bhairava

ability.name: Terror of Time
ability.description: Inflict fear on all enemies: each loses 2 of their highest stat from existential dread.

figures.description: The fierce form of Shiva who roams cremation grounds and represents the terrifying aspect of liberation.

figures.name: Virabhadra

ability.name: Daksha's Ruin
ability.description: Destroy one enemy's most powerful ability permanently as Virabhadra destroyed the sacrifice.

figures.description: Shiva's wrathful warrior manifestation created from his matted hair who destroyed Daksha's cosmic sacrifice.

figures.name: Sati

ability.name: Sacred Fire
ability.description: When this card is destroyed, grant all remaining allies +3 to all stats from the power of sacrifice.

figures.description: Shiva's first wife who immolated herself when her father Daksha dishonored Shiva, reborn as Parvati.

figures.name: Skanda/Kartikeya (Shaiva)

ability.name: Divine Lance
ability.description: Deal 7 damage and pierce all defenses; cannot be dodged or blocked.

figures.description: God of war and Shiva's martial son born from the Pleiades, commander of the divine armies.

figures.name: Andhaka

ability.name: Blindness Curse
ability.description: Inflict blindness on one enemy: they attack randomly for 2 turns.

figures.description: The blind demon born from Shiva's blinded gaze who was defeated after a cosmic battle and eventually liberated.

figures.name: Tripurasura

ability.name: Three Cities
ability.description: Protect three different allies simultaneously for 1 turn from the triple-city defense.

figures.description: The great demon who ruled the three floating cities and was destroyed in a single arrow shot by Shiva.

figures.name: Daksha

ability.name: Wounded Pride
ability.description: Reduce one enemy's wisdom by 3 permanently for failing to acknowledge higher power.

figures.description: The proud Prajapati whose exclusion of Shiva from his sacrifice led to Sati's death and cosmic destruction.

figures.name: Chandeshvara

ability.name: Devotee's Grace
ability.description: Gain 2 HP each turn that a Shiva-affiliated ally is in play.

figures.description: The supreme devotee who was made a commander in Shiva's divine retinue for his absolute unwavering devotion.

figures.name: Manasa

ability.name: Snake Queen
ability.description: Inflict snake venom on one enemy; all serpent allies gain +2 power.

figures.description: Goddess of serpents born from Shiva's mind who rules over snakebite and fertility in the eastern traditions.

figures.name: Ardhanarishvara

ability.name: Perfect Union
ability.description: This card has both power and magic at their combined maximum; choose which to apply each turn.

figures.description: The androgynous form of Shiva united with Parvati representing the inseparable nature of masculine and feminine.

figures.name: Shiva Lingam

ability.name: Pillar of Fire
ability.description: This card has no position; it cannot be targeted or moved and grants +2 magic to all Shiva allies.

figures.description: The formless pillar of fire and light representing Shiva's infinite nature that neither Brahma nor Vishnu could measure.

figures.name: Veerbhadra

ability.name: Gana Strike
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to one enemy; summon one gana warrior ally with 4/4/4/4/4 stats.

figures.description: One of Shiva's fierce Gana (attendant) warriors who fights on behalf of the great god in cosmic battles.

figures.name: Nandikesvara

ability.name: Transmitter of Grace
ability.description: Grant one ally the knowledge of one sealed enemy ability.

figures.description: Nandi in his divine human form as teacher who transmits Shiva's cosmic wisdom to seekers.

figures.name: Mahakala

ability.name: Great Time
ability.description: Skip one enemy's turn: time devours their action before it can manifest.

figures.description: The form of Shiva as great time (Mahakala) who devours all existence in his relentless advance.

figures.name: Dhumavati

ability.name: Widow's Smoke
ability.description: Inflict smoke on all enemies: each loses 2 speed and cannot see clearly for 1 turn.

figures.description: The smoky widow Mahavidya associated with inauspiciousness, chaos and the transformative power of rejection.
